Intro: Marşalla xattar! I hope you seed a great fortune in these recipes. Do you love the aroma? Verehn has yet to taste the fields of Moġara, my friend…
Actually, I wish to thank a patron here, if I may. A masked doctor gave me directions to this place some time ago. Is he here now?
I heard he is trying to solve the Spoilage happening around here. God bless him, for many good people still lie in these rotten buildings!
In other news, I want to try a new recipe from Moġara, a [DISH] to be specific. I trust you are capable of making it well, young cook.
Success: A delightful aroma. It may not be the finest, but it is distinctly Mogaran. Thank you, young cook.
Fail: Oh dear! I hope the Spoilage clears out soon. I dread seeing my people's cooking so… butchered like this.
Reject: Where's the doctor? Good people will never accept this kind of treatment. Let me go!
